value.rationale: The entire C2×C2 alternating homology character of a natural infinite family of topological complexes is determined. The half-turn period doubles the 28-period ordinary Euler invariant, with bounded nonconstant values ±1,±3,±5; at n=8 the new character splits the natural five-dimensional rational top homology into symmetry types (2,1,0,2). This information is not determined by known Betti numbers, and is motivated by inherent geometric reflections rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
